name: obm-benchmark-task-builder
description: Guided benchmark task production for OBM-style proposals, skills, verifiers, and delivery packages.

interface.shortDescription: Design, build, validate, and package benchmark tasks.
interface.longDescription: A guided wizard that turns a real work problem, repository, or system into a benchmark proposal and delivery package, with optional Trae execution and humanizer support.
defaultPrompt: Help me design a benchmark task from my work.
Review this idea and choose the best benchmark and A/B/C type.
Build and validate the complete benchmark delivery package.
